- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:621 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The `[skip ai]` fallback checks raw `PR_TITLE` and `PR_BODY` instead of the cached PR text, so a `workflow_dispatch` run with an identity-lookup failure can route a genuine twin-sync PR into Claude-fixer review and auto-merge guard changes without owner approval.
  WHY: Dispatch inputs are empty while the fetched PR body contains `[skip ai]`; severity differed between MAJOR and BLOCKER, so the highest severity is used.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:584-589, 621-624 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: When the bot identity lookup fails, the gate proceeds into AI review rather than safely preventing execution or auto-merge for a matching twin-sync PR whose identity cannot be established.
  WHY: A transient API failure can cause a genuine sync PR to be treated as an ordinary Claude PR and become eligible for auto-merge.
- scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:282-286 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: The auto-merge helper has no suppressor for `claude/claude-twin-sync-*` branches.
  WHY: A clean review of a matching PR can invoke auto-merge even though the twin-sync workflow requires owner approval.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:592 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The emitted `AUTOFIX_GATE_TWIN_SYNC_NOT_EXEMPT` prefix is absent from the contractual stable-prefix registries.
  WHY: Log-analysis tooling that relies on the registries will not classify this diagnostic prefix.

  WHY: The registry contract requires the prefix to be listed so log-analysis tooling can recognize it.

  WHY: The marker-comment check does not run on the exempt path, so sharing the lookup does not offset the new request.

- docs/plans/issue-5610-limit-twin-sync-review-skip-plan.md:102-106 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The implementation plan refers to `gate_twin_sync_pat_login`, but the shipped workflow defines and uses `gate_pat_login`.
  WHY: Maintainers following the plan will look for an identifier that does not exist in the workflow.
- tests/test_review_autofix_claude_fixer_mode.py:640-663 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The tests do not cover a `workflow_dispatch` run with empty raw title/body inputs, an identity lookup failure, and an API-fetched `[skip ai]` marker.
  WHY: The missing scenario is the dispatch failure path that lets a genuine sync PR reach Claude-fixer review and potentially auto-merge.
